text:
Findings:
1. race-on-subscribe: subscribe checks then inserts with a yield; concurrent requests can both win.
2. welcome-not-idempotent: mailer ignores the idempotency key and can send duplicate welcomes.
3. deep-import-boundary: email handler imports SubscriberStore from subscription-service.
4. email-in-info-log: subscriber email is written to an info log line after confirm.
5. failed-send-acked: on SMTP failure the handler logs and does not rethrow, so the event is lost.
